# Supplemental Rust dependency notices

Some locked Cargo archives omit standalone license files. The original upstream
notices, or the archive's original author/license declarations together with the
applicable license text, are retained here for redistribution in the GPUI App.
`sources.json` records package versions, upstream revisions where available,
source URLs and exact file hashes. All files are from public dependency sources;
no user runtime configuration or native Harness material belongs here.

The builder copies supplements only for target dependencies lacking packaged
notices and verifies every digest. The resulting App inventory links each crate
to its exact public source archive, including MPL-licensed dependencies. A new
version lacking its corresponding notices must be reviewed before distribution.
